user.title: Connect to UniFi Network
user.description: Enter the connection details of your UniFi Network controller.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the UniFi console or controller.
data_description.port: Usually 443 for UniFi OS consoles or 8443 for a self-hosted controller.
data_description.username: A local UniFi account is recommended (no 2FA / UI.com account).
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable only if the controller uses a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate UniFi Network
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {host} are no longer valid. Please enter them again.
